# The capabilities audit of a -linkshared executable must not decode an
# interface type that lives in a shared library: its descriptor name is
# mangled, so the linker holds no data for it (golang.org/issue/44031), and
# deadcode skips the R_USEIFACEMETHOD marker there. The audit skips it too
# and follows every exported method implementation from that call site,
# since a dynamic link keeps every method and the library can name any of them.
# Setup: the runtime pair (libruntime,sync-atomic.so) first, then the library
# a holding the interface and the library b that calls it, as in the upstream
# testshared issue44031 fixture. -linkshared works in GOPATH mode only. Plain
# go never writes -logos.cap, so each executable link hands the linker its
# policy file through -ldflags and no other policy reaches it.
# Archive members unpack relative to $GOPATH/src, the script's start directory,
# so package files are named capshared/... and the policy files $WORK/....
# RED expectation: every executable fails to link with a missing-symbol panic
# from the audit, and with the guard alone the denied executable would link
# clean because nothing reaches the type's method from a visible call.
[!buildmode:shared] skip
[short] skip
[!cgo] skip '-buildmode=shared requires external linking'
[!GOOS:linux] skip

env GO111MODULE=off
env GOPATH=$WORK/gopath
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

go install -buildmode=shared -pkgdir=$WORK/pkgdir runtime sync/atomic
go install -buildmode=shared -linkshared -pkgdir=$WORK/pkgdir capshared/a
go install -buildmode=shared -linkshared -pkgdir=$WORK/pkgdir capshared/b

# Control: an executable whose type implements the shared interface with no
# sink links, and the call through the shared interface is inlined so the
# marker names the shared type.
go build -linkshared -pkgdir=$WORK/pkgdir -ldflags=-logos.cap=$WORK/cap-deny.json -gcflags=capshared/cleanmain=-m -o $WORK/bin/clean capshared/cleanmain
stderr 'inlining call to b\.F'
! stderr 'capabilities::'

# An exported method implementation that reaches exec is denied through the
# skipped marker, since the value reaches the call only through any.
! go build -linkshared -pkgdir=$WORK/pkgdir -ldflags=-logos.cap=$WORK/cap-deny.json -gcflags=capshared/sinkmain=-m -o $WORK/bin/sink capshared/sinkmain
stderr 'inlining call to b\.F'
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''capshared/sinkdep'' reaches ''syscall\.Exec'''
stderr '1\. main\.main\(\) +at [^ ]+\.go:\d+'
stderr 'capshared/sinkdep\.[^ ]*M\(\) +at [^ ]+\.go:\d+'
! stderr 'unauthorized_(cgo|net|reflect)'

# Control: the same executable links when the policy allows exec.
go build -linkshared -pkgdir=$WORK/pkgdir -ldflags=-logos.cap=$WORK/cap-allow.json -o $WORK/bin/sink capshared/sinkmain
! stderr 'capabilities::'

-- $WORK/cap-deny.json --
{"transitive_reflect":"allow","transitive_exec":"deny","transitive_net":"allow","main_modules":[],"cgo_allowed":[]}
-- $WORK/cap-allow.json --
{"transitive_reflect":"allow","transitive_exec":"allow","transitive_net":"allow","main_modules":[],"cgo_allowed":[]}
-- capshared/a/a.go --
package a

type ATypeWithALoooooongName interface { // a long name, so the type descriptor symbol name is mangled
	M()
}
-- capshared/b/b.go --
package b

import "capshared/a"

var i a.ATypeWithALoooooongName

func Set(x any) { i = x.(a.ATypeWithALoooooongName) }

func F() { i.M() }
-- capshared/sinkdep/sinkdep.go --
package sinkdep

import "syscall"

type T struct{}

func (T) M() {
	syscall.Exec("/bin/true", nil, nil)
}
-- capshared/cleandep/cleandep.go --
package cleandep

type T struct{}

func (T) M() {}
-- capshared/sinkmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"capshared/b"
	"capshared/sinkdep"
)

//go:noinline
func launder(x any) any { return x }

func main() {
	b.Set(launder(sinkdep.T{}))
	b.F()
}
-- capshared/cleanmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"capshared/b"
	"capshared/cleandep"
)

//go:noinline
func launder(x any) any { return x }

func main() {
	b.Set(launder(cleandep.T{}))
	b.F()
}
